papers.title: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Process reward models enable fine-grained, step-level evaluation of LLMs, yet building them for agentic settings remains prohibitively difficult: long-horizon interactions, irreversible actions, and stochastic environment feedback make both human annotation and Monte Carlo estimation infeasible at scale. papers.llm_reason: 直击 Agent 工程最实用的'过程奖励'难题：构建 agent 专用的 process reward model 因长程交互、不可逆动作、随机环境反馈而极难规模化标注。本文证明 RL 后训练本身已提供有效的步级评分信号(Progress Advantage)，无需再单独训奖励模型——这是直接可迁移到自有 agent 训练流水线的'免费午餐'。理论上对应'PRM 的价值不在独立模型而在优势函数重用'，工程上对应'把 PPO/GRPO 训练中的 advantage 当作步骤质量标签'，本周即可做最小验证。证据以方法+对照实验为主，作者背景(Oh 等，agent/RL 方向)可信；代码/benchmark 暂无/待核验。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Sampled Demonstrations Reduces Output Diversity
papers.abstract: On-policy self-distillation achieves strong pass@1 accuracy by using a single model as both teacher and student, with the teacher conditioned on a correct demonstration to provide dense token-level feedback. We show that this could come at a hidden cost: rollout diversity decreases and pass@k curves flatten (i.e., generating more rollouts fails to improve accuracy). papers.llm_reason: 揭示 on-policy 自蒸馏的一个隐藏代价：用采样 demo 当 teacher 条件会让 rollout 多样性下降、pass@k 曲线变平(生成更多候选也无法提升准确率)，并追溯到 teacher 打分偏差的累积放大。这对所有做 RLHF/自蒸馏/拒绝采样的工程团队都是直接警示——'准确率涨了但多样性塌了'是真实陷阱。作者来自 MILA(Courville)，方法严谨、实验完整。属趋势性/警示性发现而非立即可上线方案，故给趋势分。代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: Model Forensics: Investigating Whether Concerning Behavior Reflects Misalignment
papers.abstract: A central goal of safety research is determining whether a model is misaligned. Prior work has largely focused on detecting concerning behavior. But behavior alone does not establish misalignment: a concerning action can arise from benign causes such as confusion. This motivates model forensics: investigating whether the action was driven by malign intent. papers.title: Same Evidence, Different Answer: Auditing Order Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Standard benchmarks for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) score each item on one canonical ordering and miss whether order-irrelevant shuffling changes the answer, a baseline reliability property called for by emerging AI evaluation guidelines. papers.llm_reason: 评测可靠性线：提出 Facet-Probe 五维度审计(选项/证据块/文档排序/图片集/混合模态顺序)，发现'同一证据换顺序就换答案'是 18 个前沿 MLLM 的普遍可靠性缺陷，并用贝叶斯 IRT 模型把'顺序噪声'与'维度偏差'分离。这直接挑战现有 benchmark 单一标准排序的打分有效性，对所有做 MLLM 评测/选型的团队都有方法论价值。作者来自 Stanford(Adeli/Koyejo)，方法设计完整。属评测方法论趋势而非即时工程方案，给趋势分。代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: Real-Time Voice AI Hears but Does Not Listen
papers.abstract: Speech conveys information through both words and vocal delivery. papers.llm_reason: 多模态/语音 AI 评测 + 安全线：评测四大生产级实时语音系统(GPT Realtime 2 / Gemini 3.1 Flash Live / Qwen3.5 Omni Plus & Flash)，发现它们只听'词'不听'声音'(对哭诉坚持没事的来电者仍挂断、批准语气异常的电汇)——揭示 paralinguistic(副语言)信号在生产级语音 agent 中系统性缺失。这是语音 Agent 上线的真实安全隐患。作者 Federico Bianchi、James Zou(Stanford)，证据扎实(多系统对照)。属生产级评测/安全趋势线，给趋势分。代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: RevengeBench: Reverse Engineering Code-Space Policies from Behavioral Experiments
papers.abstract: For most of scientific history, researchers studying behavior could only infer hidden mechanisms from outward actions: an inverse problem that becomes more tractable when observation is augmented by targeted intervention. We pose a computational analogue: given only behavioral traces of an agent in a game environment, can a learner reconstruct the underlying decision program as executable code, and how much does this reconstruction improve with the ability to design controlled experiments? papers.llm_reason: RevengeBench：从游戏环境中 agent 的行为轨迹反推出可执行代码形式的决策程序，并研究'主动设计受控实验'能把重构提升多少。这是'逆向工程 agent 策略'的可解释性方向，概念新颖(行为→代码的逆问题)。但与 Agent 工程主线的直接转化性偏弱、设定限于游戏环境，价值在于'策略可解释/可审计'这条长尾观察线。代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models build on a Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone by attaching an action module and optimizing the full policy jointly. This design inherits strong visual and linguistic priors from the VLM, but leaves the action module to learn physical motion almost from scratch.
